title: nixos/udev: include all rules from systemd in /etc
reason: Applicable: changed-file list includes nixos/modules/services/hardware/udev.nix (a real nixos/modules/services/** file). Wired test confirmed: the PR's own diff directly touches nixos/tests/installer.nix (swapping systemdMinimal.out for systemd.out to match the module change), and nixos/tests/all-tests.nix at head (ca3961f7) wires it twice: 'installer = handleTest ./installer.nix { systemdStage1 = false; };' and 'installer-systemd-stage-1 = handleTest ./installer.nix { systemdStage1 = true; };' (lines 867-868). No dedicated udev*.nix test file exists (confirmed via a scoped nixos/tests top-level directory listing and a GitHub code search for 'udev' scoped to path:nixos/tests, which returned other hits like installer.nix/kmonad.nix/os-prober.nix but nothing named for udev itself); installer.nix is the real wired test for this module.
targets_toml: single target udev, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,udev], watch=[enable]. The real diff touches only implementation code (derivation logic building/verifying udev rule packages, systemd package source swap, a tpm2_id builtin check, a version-gated udevadm verify) -- zero mkOption/mkEnableOption/mkRenamedOptionModule declaration lines are textually touched. Baseline services.udev.enable (mkEnableOption at line 240 of the head module) was confirmed present; only that baseline option was watched.

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: Unchanged verdict on both sides (raw.json audit-diff reports 'unchanged':1, 'changed':0, empty oba_verdict_transitions) -- not a transition at all, and not PASS on either side, so no PASS-involving asymmetry to flag. Exit code 2 on all three commands despite well-formed complete JSON (tool_error=false); consistent with oba's apparent convention of nonzero exit whenever any verdict is non-PASS/inconclusive.
